- Amazon: net sales rose from $574,785M in FY2023 to $637,959M in FY2024 [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt — Amazon.com 10-K FY2024, accession 0001018724-25-000004], a gain of 10.99%.

**Meta grew faster**, by approximately 10.95 percentage points (21.94% − 10.99%). Note that Meta's faster percentage growth comes off a revenue base roughly one-quarter the size of Amazon's; in absolute dollars Amazon added ~$63.2B versus Meta's ~$29.6B.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster — 21.9% vs. Amazon's 11.0%, a difference of about 10.95 percentage points.
